scripts.build: cmake --build build --parallel && (if not exist dist mkdir dist) && (if exist build\cling.exe copy build\cling.exe dist\) && (if exist build\test_cling.exe copy build\test_cling.exe dist\) && (if exist build\cling_test.exe copy build\cling_test.exe dist\cling_test_suite.exe)
scripts.build:wasm: emcmake cmake -B build-wasm -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && emmake cmake --build build-wasm --target cling_wasm && (if not exist dist mkdir dist) && copy build-wasm\cling.js dist\ && copy build-wasm\cling.wasm dist\
scripts.build:tree-sitter: npm run generate-grammar && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DWITH_TREE_SITTER=ON && cmake --build build --parallel
